lines.text: Project  Lumen-1
Product  6U CubeSat, single visible camera
Launch  Falcon 9 rideshare, piggyback, inside a CubeSat dispenser on a rideshare plate
Orbit assumed for the image requirement  sun-synchronous, 500 km
Review  Preliminary Design Review (PDR)
Configuration  One string. One detector, one detector controller, one power feed, one refractive lens.
No cold spare, no cross-strap, no second aperture.
The lens is held by an aluminium barrel. Retainers are staked with a commercial silicone. The baffle is black-anodized aluminium. The bandpass filter is a stock coated glass element.
The project states that the dispenser vendor covers launch loads, and that the camera is therefore not qualified for them.
MIS-01  Image land areas in daylight from the stated orbit and return the frames to the ground.
REQ-IMG-01  From 500 km, the ground sample distance shall be 20 m or finer at nadir. Method: Test. Level: Equipment. Stage: Acceptance. Parent: MIS-01.
REQ-IMG-02  The spectral band shall be 450 nm to 700 nm. Method: Inspection. Level: Equipment. Stage: Qualification. Parent: MIS-01.
REQ-IMG-03  The on-orbit modulation transfer function at Nyquist shall be at least 0.15. Parent: MIS-01.
REQ-IMG-03 verification  method: none. level: none. stage: none.
REQ-MEC-01  The camera shall survive the Falcon 9 rideshare mechanical environment with no permanent loss of optical alignment. Method: Test. Level: Equipment. Stage: Qualification. Parent: MIS-01.
REQ-REL-01  The camera reliability shall be 0.95 over a 2-year mission. Method: Review of design. Level: Equipment. Stage: Qualification. Parent: MIS-01.
Verification matrix  REQ-IMG-03 has no method, no level, and no stage. Nothing is submitted for customer approval on that row.

Materials in view of the detector  Stock glass lens, commercial catalogue part, no lot data. Silicone stake on the retainers, commercial grade, no screening record. Black anodized aluminium baffle. Coated glass filter, stock part.
No cleanliness level. No clean-room class for integration. No bake-out. No witness sample. No list of materials screened for outgassing. No prohibition on materials that deposit on glass.
Integration procedure  assemble on a clean bench.
Test campaign planned  Bench functional test of the detector and controller at room temperature. Visual inspection of the filter band edges. GSD check by analysis of pixel scale and orbit altitude.
Not planned, and marked not applicable — dispenser vendor covers launch: random vibration, sinusoidal vibration, shock, static load or sine burst, acoustic.
No qualification model and no protoflight model are identified.
Reliability claim  Reliability is 0.95 because the detector is a commercial part and cameras of this class have flown.
No failure-modes list. No worksheet. No single-point-failure record. No severity. No detection or recovery.
The architecture is one string by choice, recorded as a mass saving.
Interface note  Falcon 9 rideshare, CubeSat dispenser, fully containerized. Launch loads are the dispenser's problem. Lumen-1 has no structural qualification.
